entities.name: Édouard de Laveleye
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Édouard-Émile-Albert de Laveleye was a Belgian mining engineer, financier and writer. Laveleye was the first chairman of the Belgian Football Association (1895–1924), and also the first president of the Belgian Olympic Committee (1906–23).

entities.summary: Baron Édouard-Émile-Albert de Laveleye was a Belgian mining engineer, financier and writer. Laveleye was the first chairman of the Belgian Football Association (1895–1924), and also the first president of the Belgian Olympic Committee (1906–23).
